title: School Days: Personal Journeys
shared_passage: Listen to four people share their personal school experiences, and for questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: Why does Sam mention the essays?
options: To describe how hard he has to work.
Because he is proud of his last essay.
To state that he needs to stop.

questions.question: Why are Sam's exams so crucial?
options: Because it's his last semester.
Because he wants to study in a foreign country.
Because he needs a good mark in German.

questions.question: Why did Jessica have to drop a class last term?
options: Because she wanted more flexibility in her schedule.
Because balancing both work and school was too much.
Because the assignments were too hard.

questions.question: What does Jessica say she's learning from studying online?
options: How to use digital tools.
How to be more productive.
How to work with people.

questions.question: Why did Liam have to retake some exams?
options: Because he didn't take them when he was at school.
Because they weren't easy.
Because his marks weren't good enough.

questions.question: What would Liam like to do after his graduation?
options: Pursue advanced studies in engineering.
Start a business.
Work in a different field.

questions.question: Why didn't Daniel get good grades in high school?
options: He had trouble adapting to all the changes.
He was hanging out with the wrong people.
He didn't understand the importance of studying.
